keyword: how much does last place at the masters make
claims: At the 2026 Masters, professional golfers who miss the 36-hole cut receive a prize money payout of $25,000.
The total purse for the 2026 Masters is $22.5 million.
At the 2026 Masters, players who make the cut but finish outside the top 50 receive diminishing payouts starting from roughly $56,700 for 50th.
Bryson DeChambeau missed the cut at the 2026 Masters.
